operations.label: Combine CdO, ODE and oleic acid
Stir the precursor mixture under vacuum
Heat until the precursor solution is clear
operations.description: Clear-solution endpoint; source does not specify the heating apparatus.

operations.label: Heat to develop the selected orange shade

endpoint.value: Desired shade of orange for the selected nanocrystal size

operations.description: Yellow-to-orange change; stop heating at the shade selected for the desired size after experimental trials. No timed dwell is supplied.

operations.label: Cool immediately on ice and add toluene
operations.description: Ice bath is explicitly reported; numerical cooling temperature and rate are not.

operations.label: Filter into two large centrifuge tubes

toluene_adjusted_volume.qualifier: Source says volume of both tubes adjusted to 30 mL; per-tube versus combined volume unresolved.

filter_specification.qualifier: Printed volume unit is unresolved; not corrected to a pore-size unit.

operations.label: Precipitate white impurities and retain orange solution
operations.description: Discard the white precipitate of unreacted starting material and collect the orange solutions. Retained product is the liquid at this stage.

operations.label: Precipitate CdSe from each solution aliquot
operations.description: Centrifuge; retain the orange oil at the bottom and discard the clear top solvent. Repeat processing until all solution has been handled; this is not a fixed number of wash cycles.

operations.label: Combine oils and flocculate again
operations.description: Transfer combined oils to a smaller centrifuge tube with toluene to total 7 mL, add 7 mL methanol and centrifuge. Retain orange oil.

operations.label: Use dichloromethane and equal-volume ethanol
operations.description: Centrifuge and retain product; repeat until a thick orange oil or powder is obtained. Repeat count not reported.

operations.label: Sonicate and centrifuge in acetone

repetition_statement.qualifier: Source says this was repeated five times; initial-versus-total count not resolved.

operations.description: Retain CdSe; no centrifuge speed or duration specified for these wash cycles.

notes: 113 mg yield belongs to the stated isolation. Optical size/QY and Table 1 coverage are source ensemble contexts, not proven to be this exact physical batch.
Figure 1 representative particles; UV-derived size corroborated qualitatively by TEM, with low-contrast caveat in footnote 26.

measurements.conditions: Yu et al. calibration cited; not a site-calculated diameter.
Quinine sulfate in 0.1 N H2SO4, reference QY54.6%; detailed SI method excluded.

quality.review_scope: Admitted 13-page main paper only; scoped preparations and comparisons. Locally present screening-held SI excluded. No complete-paper or SI-reviewed claim.
missing_fields: No measured atomic coordinates or complete unit cell reported in the inspected main scope.
Detailed porphyrin precursor syntheses and SI luminescence/QY methods remain unreviewed because the local SI is screening-held.
Record/sample IDs distinguish source contexts, not independently established physical batch IDs.
Reaction-vessel geometry, growth dwell, most centrifugation speeds/times and drying conditions unreported.
conflicts: Main p.11 prints syringe-filter specification 0.22 µL; the apparent dimensional error remains unresolved.
Main p.11 says the volume of both tubes was adjusted to 30 mL; per-tube versus combined volume is not specified.
Main p.11 acetone treatment was repeated five times; whether this includes the initial treatment is unresolved.
